title: DAFTAR
description: FOUR SONGS. ONE WORKDAY. Om Nandurkar's upcoming concept album capturing office life, corporate chaos, stolen coffee breaks, and evening local train fatigue.
story: Written during late office hours and daily local train commutes across Mumbai. 'DAFTAR' tells the story of a single 9-to-5 workday—from morning desk setups and stolen printer glances, to terrace tea breaks, evening burnout, and the quiet relief of heading home.
